methods.description: Live editor summary: current scene name and kind, entity count, frame index, fps.
methods.name: info

methods.description: Read a bounded tail of the live editor console. Filter by minimumLevel (verbose/info/warn/error), category, message text, or monotonic afterSeq for incremental polling.
methods.name: console.logs

methods.description: List every entity in the live scene with id, name, and world position.
methods.name: scene.entities

methods.description: Full detail for one entity by id: name, world position, scale, and its component type list.
methods.name: scene.get

methods.description: Create an entity in the live scene. Returns its id.
methods.name: scene.create

methods.description: Add a model file to the live scene as one operation - the seamless equivalent of dragging a glTF into the editor. Bakes the raw glTF if it hasn't been imported yet, then spawns the correct layout: a lone static mesh sits on a single entity, while a multi-primitive or skinned model becomes a root with one child per primitive (each carrying its own material and skin). 'path' is a project:// or absolute model path; optional 'name', 'position', 'rotationEuler' (degrees) and 'scale' place it (skinned models authored in centimetres usually want scale ~0.01). Returns the root id and primitive count.
methods.name: scene.add_model

methods.description: Rename an entity by id.
methods.name: scene.rename

methods.description: Set an entity's parent by id. parent=0 unparents it to the scene root.
methods.name: scene.parent

methods.description: Set an entity's transform (position / rotationEuler in degrees / scale) by id.
methods.name: scene.transform

methods.description: Delete an entity from the live scene by id.
methods.name: scene.delete

methods.description: Add a component to an entity by id. 'type' is a ComponentCatalog name (call list_component_types for the set).
methods.name: scene.add_component

methods.description: Remove a component from an entity by id ('type' is a ComponentCatalog name).
methods.name: scene.remove_component

methods.description: Read a component's editable fields - the same fields the Inspector shows - as a JSON object. 'type' is a component name (call list_component_types for the set and each type's fields). Returns {id, type, fields:{...}}, or an error if the entity lacks that component.
methods.name: scene.get_component

methods.description: Set one or more editable fields on a component - the programmatic equivalent of editing it in the Inspector. 'type' is a component name; 'values' is an object mapping field name -> value for ONLY the fields you want to change (partial update; call get_component or list_component_types for field names/types). Colours/vectors are [x,y,z(,w)] arrays. Returns {id, type, applied:[...]}.
methods.name: scene.set_component

methods.description: List every component (name + category), plus, for components with editable fields, the field list get_component / set_component accept.
methods.name: scene.component_types

methods.description: Save the live scene to its committable .scene.toml. Defaults to the current scene; pass 'name' to save under a different name.
methods.name: scene.save

methods.description: Switch the live editor to a scene by name (tears the current scene down first).
methods.name: scene.load

methods.description: Replace the live scene with a fresh empty scene.
methods.name: scene.new

methods.description: Enter Play mode (async): rebuild the C# scripts on a worker thread, then snapshot + start. Returns immediately with state='compiling'; poll info.playState until 'playing'. The editor never blocks. Mirrors the Play button.
methods.name: engine.play

methods.description: Exit Play mode and restore the pre-play scene snapshot.
methods.name: engine.stop

methods.description: Toggle Play/Stop.
methods.name: engine.toggle_play

methods.description: Dump the live render graph: every compiled pass with its type, dependencies, produced/consumed frame products, and last CPU time.
methods.name: rendergraph

methods.description: Render-graph frame statistics: pass/barrier counts, transient-image cache hit/miss, and the transient GPU heap capacity vs. bytes used - the engine's per-frame allocation profile.
methods.name: render.stats

methods.description: Per-pass CPU-time benchmark of the last rendered frame: every compiled pass's CPU cost (ms), sorted slowest-first, plus the hottest pass, total graph CPU time and this frame's fps. Poll repeatedly to sample min/avg/max over time.
methods.name: render.benchmark

methods.description: Capture the current Launcher hub frame to a .png and return its path. Pass 'path' or get a default under %LOCALAPPDATA%/AetherCore/screenshots.
methods.name: viewport.screenshot

methods.description: List every registered texture / render target (shadow atlas, GBuffer, scene color, asset textures): name, format, extent, aspect, mips, layers, bindless slot.
methods.name: render.textures

methods.description: Capture a registered texture / render target (name from list_textures) to a .png and return its path - use it to SEE any GPU texture, not just the viewport. Handles 8-bit color, depth (normalized grayscale) and HDR (tonemapped) targets.
methods.name: render.capture_texture

methods.description: Per-component-type entity counts in the live scene - a histogram over the ECS storage pools.
methods.name: scene.stats

methods.description: Every light in the live scene: id, name, type (point/spot), world position, color, intensity, radius, shadow-casting flag (spots also report cone angles and aim direction).
methods.name: scene.lights

methods.description: Active camera: projection mode, world position, forward direction, vertical field of view, and orthographic height.
methods.name: camera.info

methods.description: Current engine settings: resolution, vsync, and target fps.
methods.name: settings.get

methods.description: List every editor panel/window and whether it is currently open. Names feed set_window.
methods.name: editor.windows

methods.description: Open or close an editor panel by name (from list_windows; case-insensitive), e.g. show the Inspector so a screenshot captures it.
methods.name: editor.window_set

methods.description: Open the Inspector and scroll a specific component's drawer into view (force-opening it), e.g. 'Rigid Body' or 'Material'. Select an entity first. Matches the section label case-insensitively - use it to frame a component for a screenshot.
methods.name: editor.inspect_component

methods.description: Select a project asset by path (project:// or absolute). The File Explorer mirrors it (preview card) and the Inspector shows the asset. Kind is inferred from the extension.
methods.name: asset.select

methods.description: Select an entity by id (0 clears the selection). The Inspector shows the selected entity - select first, then open the Inspector to work on / screenshot it.
methods.name: scene.select

methods.description: The current editor selection: the primary entity id (0 if none) plus all selected ids.
methods.name: scene.selection

methods.description: Live Launcher summary: recent-project count, handoff state, frame index, and fps.
methods.name: launcher.info

methods.description: List the Launcher's recent projects, including each project name and root path.
methods.name: launcher.projects

methods.description: Open an existing AetherCore project and hand the control port from the Launcher to its Editor process.
methods.name: launcher.open_project

methods.description: Create a Blank 2D or Blank 3D project, then hand the control port from the Launcher to its Editor process.
methods.name: launcher.create_project

methods.description: Create up to 10,000 entities in one request. Each item accepts name/transform plus optional components with initial reflected values. Processing is one editor-frame command; failures are reported per item and a failed item's partial entity is rolled back.
methods.name: scene.create_many

methods.description: Set transforms for up to 10,000 entities in one request. Returns ordered per-item results with partial failures instead of aborting the batch.
methods.name: scene.transform_many

methods.description: Delete up to 10,000 entities in one request. Returns ordered per-item results with partial failures.
methods.name: scene.delete_many

methods.description: Add components to up to 10,000 entities in one request. Each item may also provide reflected field values, combining add and initialize without another round trip.
methods.name: scene.add_component_many

methods.description: Remove components from up to 10,000 entities in one request, with ordered per-item results.
methods.name: scene.remove_component_many

methods.description: Apply reflected component field updates to up to 10,000 entities in one request, with ordered per-item applied-field or error results.
methods.name: scene.set_component_many

methods.description: Create a tileset (every atlas sprite becomes a paintable tile) plus an empty tilemap, and bind the tilemap to an entity's Tile Map component when 'id' is given. Returns tileset/tilemap paths and the paintable tile list.
methods.name: tiles.create

solid.description: give every tile Full collision (default false)

methods.description: Inspect an entity's tilemap: paintable tiles (tileset indices used by paint_tiles), layers, palette usage, painted-cell bounds, and cell count.
methods.name: tiles.info

methods.description: Paint tilemap cells. Each cell is {x, y, tile?, flipX?, flipY?} where 'tile' is a tileset tile index (get_tile_map lists them); omit 'tile' to erase. Edits join the editor's undo stack. 'save' (default true) persists the tilemap asset.
methods.name: tiles.paint

methods.description: Fill (or erase, when 'tile' is omitted) an inclusive cell rect [x0, y0, x1, y1] on a tilemap layer without sending every cell. Edits join the editor's undo stack.
methods.name: tiles.fill

rect.description: cell rect [x0, y0, x1, y1], inclusive

methods.description: Read the non-empty cells of an inclusive cell rect [x0, y0, x1, y1] back as {x, y, tile, flipX, flipY} with 'tile' as a tileset index.
methods.name: tiles.read

rect.description: cell rect [x0, y0, x1, y1], inclusive

methods.description: Append a layer to an entity's tilemap and return its index (paint_tiles' 'layer' parameter).
methods.name: tiles.add_layer

methods.description: Grid-slice a texture into a sprite atlas asset (the same operation as the Sprite Slicer panel). Re-slicing an existing atlas keeps stable sprite ids where regions still correspond. Returns the atlas path and sprite list.
methods.name: atlas.slice

methods.description: List a sprite atlas' regions: index, name, and pixel rect. Indices/names feed create_sprite_animation; names identify sprites for Sprite Renderer components.
methods.name: atlas.info

methods.description: Create a sprite animation asset from atlas frames. 'frames' entries are sprite indices, sprite names, or {sprite, duration} objects; 'fps' sets the default frame duration. Assign the result to a Sprite Animator component to play it.
methods.name: animation.create

methods.description: Move the edit-mode viewport camera: 'position' ([x, y] keeps z, [x, y, z] sets it), 'height' sets the orthographic view height, and 'frame' centres on an entity. Edit mode only - the play camera belongs to the game.
methods.name: editor.camera

methods.description: Glob project files by virtual path, e.g. 'project://assets/**/*.png' or 'project://assets/**/*.spriteatlas.toml'. Feeds texture/atlas parameters on the other 2D authoring methods.
methods.name: assets.list

methods.description: Attach a C# script to an entity by type name (the class name in the project's scripts folder, e.g. 'PlayerController'). Optional 'properties' seeds public fields: numbers, bools, strings, or [x, y, z] arrays.
methods.name: scene.add_script

methods.description: List the C# scripts attached to an entity.
methods.name: scene.scripts

methods.description: Detach a C# script from an entity by type name.
methods.name: scene.remove_script

methods.description: Open the editor's Open Scene dialog (the same one as File > Open).
methods.name: editor.open_scene_dialog

methods.description: Remove a project from the Launcher's recent list (works whether the project still exists or is missing).
methods.name: launcher.remove_recent

methods.description: Open a recent project's folder in the OS file manager.
methods.name: launcher.reveal_folder

methods.description: Re-point a moved project in the recent list to a new folder (headless: no folder picker).
methods.name: launcher.relocate_recent

methods.description: List on-screen ImGui widgets from the last frame: window, label, screen rect, and hovered/active state. Optional 'window'/'label' substring filters. Use this to navigate the UI before ui_click.
methods.name: ui.query

methods.description: Click a widget by {window,label} or a raw {x,y} screen point. Optional 'button' ('left'|'right') and 'double'. Async: the click plays over a few frames; query/screenshot afterwards to see the effect.
methods.name: ui.click

methods.description: Hold the mouse over a widget ({window,label}) or {x,y}. Reveals hover-only UI (tooltips, hover buttons) and sets up a subsequent ui_click on a context-menu item. Held until the next action.
methods.name: ui.hover

methods.description: Focus a text field ({window,label} or {x,y}) and replace its contents with 'text' (select-all, delete, then type).
methods.name: ui.input_text

methods.description: Press a named key: enter, escape, tab, backspace, delete, space, left, right, up, down, home, end.
methods.name: ui.key
